name: giant-killer
_comment: Copy of the engine-v2 file (assumed layers, no number tuned) plus items. Layers unchanged: item plain modifiers are not added to them. Art slot 4 swapped to the item art metal-hundred-edge-flight (group hundred-blades-canon).
unmodelled: Half a Realm (enabler): no library art or technique does it and the engine has no fight-unit shift; lost
Against the Heavens: L5 +100 only against a higher foe; no realm-gap readable, so L5 100 is applied at every gap
Stiff Neck, Through the Ceiling, Mountain Notches, Needle's Eye, Realm-Piercing affix: not in the game, no library equivalent; lost
Realm pierce (pierce_pct) and Physical penetration: no engine field, so the pierce-to-cap job is absent
Golden Bell, Soul-Guarding Lamp, Clear Heart Ward: per-hit and soul wards are modelled as the typical Common Ward
Item plain modifiers (attack, crit, art speed, khi huyet, resist, block, stack effect and duration): layers and fields kept as the old file, no number tuned
Tortoise-Scale Shell and Bronze Peal wards: cast wards, not drain wards that beat the build's, so the typical Common Ward stays
Whetstone Jade Pendant reserve art Keen Edge Aura: reserve arts are not modelled
